image_description: A white rectangular plastic tub containing a pile of approximately six to eight Dungeness crabs. The crabs are stacked on top of each other, displaying their characteristic broad, oval, purplish-brown carapaces. Several legs and claws are visible protruding from the pile, though many are obscured by the stacking arrangement.
